A handful of very common verbs that don't belong to one theme but show up everywhere: **to see / watch** (شوف — shaaf), **to take** (أخد — a5ad), **to ask** (سأل — sa2al), **to need** (احتاج — e7tag) and **to write** (كتب — katab). Tap any sentence to reveal its franco and English.

## How it works

These five between them cover most of the verb types you've already met: **شوف** is hollow (like راح), **كتب** and **سأل** are regular (like فهم), **أخد** is a little irregular, and **احتاج** runs like اشتغل. As always, the future is **ها +** the stem, and the past uses endings.

A few patterns worth noting:

- **احتاج** takes either a thing or another verb: *ba7tag mosa3da* "I need help", *ba7tag aroo7* "I need to go".
- **سأل** pairs with **عن (3an)** "about": *bas2al 3an el-mudeer* "I ask about the manager".
- **شوف** covers *see*, *watch* and *look*.

## The five in the present

| Pronoun | شوف (see) | أخد (take) | سأل (ask) | احتاج (need) | كتب (write) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| أنا - ana | بشوف - bashoof | باخد - ba5od | بسأل - bas2al | بحتاج - ba7tag | بكتب - baktib |
| إنت - inta | بتشوف - bitshoof | بتاخد - bita5od | بتسأل - bitis2al | بتحتاج - biti7tag | بتكتب - bitiktib |
| إنتِ - inti | بتشوفي - bitshoofi | بتاخدي - bita5di | بتسألي - bitis2ali | بتحتاجي - biti7tagi | بتكتبي - bitiktibi |
| هو - huwwa | بيشوف - biyshoof | بياخد - biya5od | بيسأل - biyis2al | بيحتاج - biyi7tag | بيكتب - biyiktib |
| هي - hiyya | بتشوف - bitshoof | بتاخد - bita5od | بتسأل - bitis2al | بتحتاج - biti7tag | بتكتب - bitiktib |
| إحنا - e7na | بنشوف - binshoof | بناخد - bina5od | بنسأل - binis2al | بنحتاج - bini7tag | بنكتب - biniktib |
| إنتو - intu | بتشوفوا - bitshoofu | بتاخدوا - bita5du | بتسألوا - bitis2alu | بتحتاجوا - biti7tagu | بتكتبوا - bitiktibu |
| هم - humma | بيشوفوا - biyshoofu | بياخدوا - biya5du | بيسألوا - biyis2alu | بيحتاجوا - biyi7tagu | بيكتبوا - biyiktibu |

**Past (هو):** شاف (shaaf), أخد (a5ad), سأل (sa2al), احتاج (e7tag), كتب (katab).

## Also: to live — عايش — 3ayish

Not an action verb but a participle that just agrees: **عايش (3ayish)** m., **عايشة (3aysha)** f., **عايشين (3ayshin)** pl. — *ana 3aysh fi el-Qahira* "I live in Cairo". It comes back in the introductions chapter.

## Vocabulary

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| فيلم - film | film |
| تاكسي - taxi | taxi |
| سؤال - so2al | question |
| مساعدة - mosa3da | help |
| رسالة - resala | letter / message |
| حاجة - 7aga | thing |

## Dialogue: "Do you need anything?"

Bassem checks in on Yasmin.

<span class="rotulo">باسم — Bassem</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بتكتبي إيه؟</summary>
<span class="fr">bitiktibi eh?</span>
<span class="en">What are you writing?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">ياسمين — Yasmin</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بكتب رسالة لصاحبتي</summary>
<span class="fr">baktib resala le-sa7bti</span>
<span class="en">I'm writing a letter to my friend</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">باسم — Bassem</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>محتاجة حاجة؟</summary>
<span class="fr">me7taga 7aga?</span>
<span class="en">Do you need anything?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">ياسمين — Yasmin</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>أيوة، بحتاج أروح المكتب. هاخد تاكسي</summary>
<span class="fr">aywa, ba7tag aroo7 el-maktab. ha5od taxi</span>
<span class="en">Yes, I need to go to the office. I'll take a taxi</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">باسم — Bassem</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>هتشوفي حد هناك؟</summary>
<span class="fr">hatshoofi 7add henak?</span>
<span class="en">Will you see someone there?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">ياسمين — Yasmin</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>أيوة، هسأل عن المدير</summary>
<span class="fr">aywa, has2al 3an el-mudeer</span>
<span class="en">Yes, I'll ask about the manager</span>
</details>
